claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting implicit discourse relations with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing explicit discourse relations, achieving performance comparable to previous best results (F1 score > 90%).
The model performs particularly well on the contingency relation, with a performance improvement of 1.42%.
The model is less suitable for binary classification tasks, indicating a limitation in its performance for certain discourse relations.
